speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng (Yio Chu Kang)
text: Many retirees may downgrade or drop private coverage due to premium increases, even as MediShield Life premium also rises.

speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng (Yio Chu Kang)
text: Will the Ministry consider establishing a pricing council or having broader regulatory guardrails that helps in terms of financial security and access options for seniors as well as middle-income households?

speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
text: Having said that, I appreciate that there are concerns on the impact to consumers.

speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
text: As mentioned in previous Parliamentary Questions, firstly, information is made available, and there are a lot of guidelines to try and get people to make the best decisions.
